**Sundhedsklynge Fyn** is a regional healthcare cluster in Denmark, operating as a local organizational unit within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src5]. It is one of the many clusters evaluated in the annual quality monitoring reports published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), which assess the treatment and management of [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]] across the national healthcare system [^src1].

The cluster is notable for meeting the national clinical standards for several key quality indicators. Most prominently, Sundhedsklynge Fyn fulfills the standard for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation treatment for newly diagnosed patients, achieving a compliance rate of 90.7% [^src1]. The cluster's performance is comprehensively tracked across a wide range of metrics, including 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year treatment coverage (Indicators 4a1, 4a2, and 4a3) [^src2], annual P-creatinine measurements for patients on DOAC treatment (Indicator 4b) [^src4], and the incidence of severe bleeding and heart failure within one year of a new diagnosis (Indicators 11 and 15) [^src6]. 

Furthermore, geographic analyses of clinical outcomes include Sundhedsklynge Fyn in national mapping efforts. For instance, the cluster is included in the Denmark-wide geographic distribution analysis for [[indikator-5|Indicator 5]], which tracks the incidence of ischemic apoplexy (stroke) among atrial fibrillation patients, with cluster-level incidences mapped across intervals ranging from 0% to over 2.8% [^src4]. Through these detailed metrics, Sundhedsklynge Fyn serves as a critical local node for benchmarking, clinical development, and quality improvement in cardiovascular care within the Danish healthcare system [^src7].
